name: Report to Tarren Mill
summary: Report to Tarren Mill is a diplomatic dispatch directing Sin'dorei champions into the contested territories of Lordaeron. Commissioned by Ambassador Sunsorrow in the Undercity, it urges blood elf travelers to offer their aid to the Forsaken garrison at Tarren Mill. By proving their worth in foreign theaters of war, the blood elves hope to secure vital Horde goodwill and resources.

sections.title: A Diplomatic Calculus
sections.body: The blood elves stand as recent arrivals within the Horde, and their foothold remains fragile. In the royal corridors of the Undercity, Ambassador Sunsorrow understands that alliances are forged in blood, not merely ratified on parchment. To earn the full, active support of the Horde—and particularly the dark lady's Forsaken, who share northern kinship—the Sin'dorei must take up the mantle of their allies' regional conflicts. Directing capable adventurers into the field demonstrates that Silvermoon is a potent partner rather than a dependent supplicant.

sections.title: The Southern Outpost
sections.body: South across the Silverpine border and past the ruins of Lordaeron lies the Hillsbrad Foothills, where the Forsaken stronghold of Tarren Mill holds the line against regional enemies. It is here that Advisor Duskingdawn coordinates blood elf interests alongside Forsaken commanders. Arriving travelers are integrated directly into the town's operations, aiding the undead war effort against hostile human militia, Syndicate rogue elements, and Alliance incursions along the southern frontier.

faq.q: Why is Ambassador Sunsorrow sending blood elves to Tarren Mill?
aliases: why are elves sent to hillsbrad
faq.answer: Sunsorrow seeks to cement the newly formed bond between Silvermoon and the Horde. By assisting the Forsaken directly with their defensive and strategic struggles in the Hillsbrad Foothills, the blood elves build reciprocal trust and ensure the Horde will aid them in their own homeland.

Advisor Duskingdawn is a blood elf representative stationed at Tarren Mill in Hillsbrad Foothills. He oversees incoming Sin'dorei forces and directs them toward Forsaken commanders and local tasks that benefit the mutual war effort.

aliases: how to get to tarren mill
faq.answer: Tarren Mill is a primary Forsaken bastion located in the northern region of the Hillsbrad Foothills, situated southeast of Silverpine Forest and south of the Alterac Mountains.

faq.q: What threats face the Horde in Hillsbrad Foothills?
faq.answer: Tarren Mill faces immediate pressure from the human town of Southshore, remnants of the Syndicate hiding in ruins, aggressive wild beasts, and regional skirmishes for control of the foothills.

faq.q: Why are the Forsaken and blood elves particularly aligned?
aliases: why do elves work with undead
faq.answer: Both peoples share deep historical ties to the northern lands of Lordaeron and Quel'Thalas, having both suffered catastrophic devastation at the hands of the Scourge during the Third War. These shared wounds and geographical proximity foster practical cooperation.

faq.q: Does this mission involve combat immediately upon arrival?
aliases: is report to tarren mill dangerous
faq.answer: The mission itself is purely travel and introduction. However, once you report to Advisor Duskingdawn, he encourages you to seek out local Forsaken officers who urgently require combat assistance across Hillsbrad.

angles.text: This mission exemplifies the practical diplomacy required to unite distant kingdoms under the banner of the Horde, trading martial service for coalition support.
For the Forsaken, every arriving elven recruit strengthens the bulwark at Tarren Mill against nearby Southshore and lurking Syndicate outlaws.
